arStrings.szText: Wardens of Light. We stand for justice, not dogma. We have no ties to Zakarum or any institution of the Light.
We saw how corruption spread, diluting the Light by politics and hierarchy. We chose better.
We broke from the old systems that drained Sanctuary. Our Light isn’t passed down—it’s earned, lived, and lit from within. We take in anyone willing to walk the path and help them find their fire.
